learningObjectives: Explain the purpose of continuous integration and continuous delivery.
Identify the stages of a Java application delivery pipeline.
Design a basic CI/CD workflow for testing and deploying a Java application.

activities.title: CI/CD Pipeline Concepts
activities.instruction: Explore the major stages and purposes of a Java CI/CD pipeline.

content.concept: A CI/CD pipeline automates repeatable software-delivery tasks such as validating source changes, resolving dependencies, building, testing, packaging, and deploying applications.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Stores and triggers the pipeline from application source changes.
Compiles the Java project and resolves required dependencies.
Checks application behavior and code quality automatically.
A deployable output such as a JAR or container image.
Releases the verified artifact to a target environment.

activities.title: Pipeline Sequencer
activities.instruction: Arrange a typical Java CI/CD pipeline.

content.concept: A basic pipeline validates a source change, prepares dependencies, builds the project, runs tests, creates a deployable artifact, and deploys the verified result.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 1. Detect or receive the source-code change
3. Resolve dependencies and build the Java project
4. Run automated tests and quality checks

activities.title: Quality Gate
activities.instruction: Choose the condition that should allow a build to continue.

content.concept: A quality gate prevents a pipeline from progressing when required checks fail, such as compilation, automated tests, or configured quality checks.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: All required tests pass and the build succeeds
One required test fails but deployment should continue anyway
Compilation fails but the artifact should still be deployed
A required security check fails but the pipeline should ignore it
config.answer: All required tests pass and the build succeeds

activities.instruction: Build a complete delivery pipeline for a Java application.

content.concept: A repeatable CI/CD workflow connects source control, automated build and test stages, artifact creation, and deployment so verified Java changes can be delivered consistently.
